edges.reason: freeRollMint reads freeRollPunks[msg.sender] to determine the caller's free roll balance.
freeRollMint invokes the internal _mint routine with the resolved quantity.
freeRollPunks mapping supplies the free roll amount consumed by freeRollMint.
mint uses msg.sender for refund and safe mint recipient.
mint reads _price to compute the required payment.
mint requires isSaleOn to be true to proceed.
Excess msg.value flows into the payable(msg.sender).transfer refund call.
The refund transfer hands control to the caller while mint is still executing.
mint delegates token creation to the internal _mint function.
_mint passes msg.sender as the recipient of _safeMint.
_mint loops calling useRandomAvailableToken to pick each new token id.
_mint decrements _numAvailableTokens for each minted token.
_mint calls _safeMint which triggers the recipient onERC721Received callback.
The ERC721 receiver callback re-enters the minting code path before state is fully settled.
block.timestamp is a miner-manipulable input to the token id randomness of useRandomAvailableToken.
block.timestamp is packed into the keccak256 randomness derivation.
The keccak256 hash result supplies the pseudo-random value used by useRandomAvailableToken.
_numAvailableTokens is used as the modulus for the random index.
useRandomAvailableToken forwards the computed index to useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
_numAvailableTokens bounds the swap-and-pop inside useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
_availableTokens array is read and rewritten by useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex decrements _numAvailableTokens after consuming an index.
setPrice writes the new value into _price.
setPrice is protected by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
startSale sets isSaleOn to true.
startSale marks saleHasBeenStarted as true.
startSale is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
endSale sets isSaleOn to false.
endSale is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
giveFreeRoll credits the freeRollPunks mapping for the receiver.
giveFreeRoll increments _numFreeRollsGiven, capped below 200.
giveFreeRoll is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI writes the base URI state variable.
setBaseURI is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setContractURI writes punkcontractURI.
setContractURI is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setImageHash writes the imageHash state variable.
setImageHash is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawTeam reads the hardcoded oaf address for the 6% payout.
withdrawTeam reads the hardcoded quack address for the remainder payout.
withdrawTeam performs payable(oaf).send with the computed share.
The send to oaf forwards gas and allows re-entry before the second payout completes.
withdrawTeam performs payable(quack).send with the remainder.
The send to quack can re-enter the withdrawal logic.
withdrawTeam is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawFailsafe forwards the entire balance with a low-level call to msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient and therefore the potential re-entrant caller of the balance transfer.
The low-level call in withdrawFailsafe hands all gas to the owner enabling reentrancy.
withdrawFailsafe is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
tokenURI reads the base token URI via _baseURI.
getPrice returns _price.
getCostForMintingPunks multiplies _price by the requested quantity.
contractURI returns punkcontractURI.
getNumFreeRollPunks reads freeRollPunks[owner].

normalization_plan.reason: The quantity parameter is only meaningful as the argument of the mint function; merge into mint.
The quantity parameter governs the _mint loop bound; merge into _mint.
The quantity parameter is only used to compute the quoted cost; merge into getCostForMintingPunks.
The quantity parameter feeds the keccak256 randomness preimage; merge into useRandomAvailableToken.
The loop index feeds the keccak256 randomness preimage; merge into useRandomAvailableToken.
The index parameter drives the swap-and-pop resolution; merge into useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
The price argument is assigned to _price inside setPrice; merge into setPrice.
The receiver address is mapped in freeRollPunks inside giveFreeRoll; merge into giveFreeRoll.
The roll count is added to freeRollPunks and _numFreeRollsGiven inside giveFreeRoll; merge into giveFreeRoll.
The URI string is stored into _baseTokenURI inside setBaseURI; merge into setBaseURI.
The URI string is stored into punkcontractURI inside setContractURI; merge into setContractURI.
The hash string is stored into imageHash inside setImageHash; merge into setImageHash.
The owner address indexes balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex inside getPunksBelongingToOwner; merge into getPunksBelongingToOwner.
The token id is stringified into the metadata URI inside tokenURI; merge into tokenURI.
Local copy of the caller free roll balance used only within freeRollMint; merge into freeRollMint.
Local remaining-supply computation used only within freeRollMint; merge into freeRollMint.
Cached balance used only for the payout split inside withdrawTeam; merge into withdrawTeam.
The 6% share is the exact value passed to payable(oaf).send; merge into that unsafe send operation.
The remainder share is the exact value passed to payable(quack).send; merge into that unsafe send operation.
The local random number is the direct result of the keccak256 randomness derivation; merge into unsafe_randomness.
The working copy of _numAvailableTokens is only used inside the _mint loop; merge into _mint.
